taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station BMGS-bori-field (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1005 | 3.42 | 3.42
2 | 3588 | 6.33 | 9.76
3 | 1358 | 10.9 | 20.7
4 | 333 | 9.08 | 29.7
5 | 2950 | 36.8 | 66.5
6 | 5469 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as KQHA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: BMGS-bori-field
Curve type: KQHA
Aquifer depth: 20.7 m – 29.7 m
Recommendation: Target the low-resistivity (333 Ω·m) zone between ~20.7 m and 29.7 m depth as the primary aquifer horizon; advance drilling with core sampling through this interval to confirm lithology and water-bearing potential, and ensure proper casing through the overlying high-resistivity layers to prevent collapse.
